pages.title: Lights for the Seasons
pages.child_instruction: Color the sun, moon, and stars above the orchard God made for the seasons.
pages.bible_connection: God made lights in the sky to mark day, night, seasons, days, and years.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: evening orchard with a setting sun, rising moon, stars in a clear sky, apple trees, a simple path, and a child looking up. No letters in the artwork. Do not bake verse text into the drawing.

pages.title: Find the Sky Signs
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 sky signs. God made lights to mark seasons, days, and years.
pages.bible_connection: Noticing sun, moon, and stars is practice for remembering that God made the seasons.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled dusk-orchard background without the eight targets. Independently placed sun disk, crescent moon, star, cloud, sundial, hourglass, sparrow, and season leaf.

pages.title: Follow the Day to Night
pages.child_instruction: Start at the sunrise hill. Follow the path to the harvest moon.
pages.bible_connection: The path from day to night is a picture of the lights God made to divide day from night.
pages.visual_prompt: One hillside orchard scene: sunrise hill at START, unique hedge-and-path maze, harvest moon over the trees at FINISH. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: Thank God for the Seasons
pages.child_instruction: Check how you can notice God's seasons. Then draw your favorite time of day.
pages.bible_connection: Watching day, night, and seasons is one way a child can remember Genesis 1:14.
pages.visual_prompt: One sky-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large round sky drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.
pages.drawing_prompt: Draw your favorite time of day in God's sky
pages.prayer: God, thank You for the lights that mark our days.
